paper_title: Efficient Conventional- and Inverted-Type Photovoltaic Cells Using a Planar Alternating Polythiophene Copolymer

knowledge_points.content: PTBT is a planar alternating polythiophene copolymer designed for high-performance organic photovoltaic applications.
knowledge_points.evidence: Efficient Conventional- and Inverted-Type Photovoltaic Cells Using a Planar Alternating Polythiophene Copolymer... PTBT

knowledge_points.content: The photoluminescence (PL) spectra of PTBT are sensitive to the solvent environment, as evidenced by normalized PL measurements in different solvents.
knowledge_points.evidence: Figure S1. Normalized PL spectra of PTBT in different solvents.

knowledge_points.content: The electrochemical properties and energy levels of the PTBT polymer are determined using cyclic voltammetry performed in an acetonitrile solution.
knowledge_points.evidence: Figure S2. Cyclic voltammogram of PTBT in acetonitrile.

knowledge_points.content: PTBT-based photovoltaic cells can be fabricated in both conventional and inverted device architectures while maintaining efficiency.
knowledge_points.evidence: Efficient Conventional- and Inverted-Type Photovoltaic Cells Using a Planar Alternating Polythiophene Copolymer

knowledge_points.content: The charge transport properties of PTBT are characterized by evaluating the J-V characteristics of hole-only and electron-only devices, typically to calculate carrier mobility.
knowledge_points.evidence: Figure S3. J-V characteristics of PTBT-based hole-only and electron-only devices.

knowledge_points.content: The planar structure of the alternating polythiophene copolymer PTBT is a key design feature intended to optimize its performance in solar cell applications.
knowledge_points.evidence: Efficient Conventional- and Inverted-Type Photovoltaic Cells Using a Planar Alternating Polythiophene Copolymer
